Chinnaswamy Stadium Upgrades Floodlighting System

The Karnataka State Cricket Association (KSCA) has upgraded the floodlighting system at the Chinnaswamy Stadium. The new system utilizes state-of-the-art LED technology. This upgrade is intended to conserve energy.
